selection: Development GZSL H, then mean S/U, then lower candidate CE. Step zero is eligible. All 30 cells are completed and selections locked before evaluation.
scope: Exploratory reuse of the previously inspected CUB 20-class split. Both visual encoders, class text, temperature, and the development-selected attribute probe are frozen during fusion training. Three seeds vary only fusion initialization and training batches, not split, pretraining or attribute probe.
tokens: Three views (whole image plus two detector regions), 24 separate attribute tokens per view. Shared token MLP and single-query cross attention. Pooled control repeats the mean attribute representation 24 times per view, matching length and parameters. Region-only has zero text and confidence; constant uses training-mean per-view predicted probabilities; permuted uses a fixed incorrect text association, which could be relearned.
inference: Image only plus fixed detector, class/attribute text assets and trained weights. No image labels, true attributes, or true part locations are inference inputs. Unknown attributes are masked only during probe training and evaluation. Global attribute tokens remain available when detector regions are missing.
